title: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
script:
Anthropic just filed its S-1 paperwork to go public on the Nasdaq.
The company is asking investors to believe in its long-term AGI vision.
Joey Brookhart from SemiAnalysis is auditing the specific numbers inside this filing.
The S-1 details massive spending on compute power to train the Claude models.
Anthropic revenue must now scale to cover these immense infrastructure costs.
The Verge podcast interviewed Brookhart to explain these complex financial tradeoffs.
Will you buy stock in this AI lab?
